description: This file defines utility functions and constants for managing lock files and determining whether certain files should be excluded from git diffs, specifically focusing on package manager lock files and build artifacts.

methods.name: createLockFileIgnoreInstance
methods.description: Creates and configures an ignore instance with patterns for lock files and directories to be ignored.

methods.name: shouldExcludeLockFile
methods.description: Checks if a given filename matches ignore patterns for lock files and build artifacts, indicating it should be excluded from git diffs.
